narration: In month {fork_month}, a colleague held up his screen and a year that beat yours, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted that same month, the first sign that the two lives had different cushions to fall back on. In month {crossover_month} the ghost's money moved past yours, and it stayed in front for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, at the bottom of the fall, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {end_month} the ghost's net worth sat at its lowest since the split, and it still finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cover for a stretch with no pay closed {safety_gap}.
